free_tier.stated: 'The Foundation does not make grants to individuals except through its Books program' and 'The Alfred P. Sloan Foundation does not accept or review unsolicited grant proposals.' The only individual lane named is book writing, where 'Book grants can be made to individuals or to affiliated nonprofit organizations' and are 'typically $60,000 or less'.

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.chaining: The only individual door is a book about science, so this record's use is negative: it stops a reader from spending a week drafting a Sloan proposal that no programme would read.

limits.value: No unsolicited proposals are read at all, so the route is a letter of inquiry to a named programme director, and most programmes do not accept even that.

record.notes: Sloan appears on most lists of open-source and science funders and is the wrong shape: institution-only, no unsolicited proposals, and a book programme as the sole individual route. The USD 60,000 book ceiling is the one number a person could reach, and it buys writing time rather than compute.
